baseRates.denominatorLabel: the 259 large listed Indian companies in research/raw/companies-by-state.json

Treat every rate below as a floor, never as the answer. Neither was reachable in this pass: gem.gov.in and eprocure.gov.in did not respond to fetches from this environment.

baseRates.claim: Share of awards in this file for which a number of competing bidders could be sourced
baseRates.denominatorLabel: all 88 awards recorded in this file
baseRates.reading: 16 of 88 awards carry a bidder count; 72 do not. This is the file's most important self-diagnostic. A sole-bidder award and a twelve-bidder award are entirely different facts, and Indian central procurement publishes the winner far more reliably than it publishes the field. Where bidder counts are absent the award tells you who won and nothing about whether anyone else tried. The bidders field counts COMPANIES THAT COMPETED, never companies that won: several multi-winner rows in this file name five or eleven winners, and in every such case the bidders field is deliberately null because the size of the competing field is unpublished. Conflating the two would have raised this rate from 18.6% to 38.4% while measuring nothing. Not one of the 34 coal rows has a bidder count, and only one of the 13 roads rows does; the sectors where bidder counts do exist are airports, telecom spectrum and power transmission.

In the one round where the ministry's offered count and the bid-receipt count are both public - round 15 plus the second attempts of rounds 13 and 14, bids opened 10 Jul 2026 - 23 blocks were offered and bids were received for only 8, from 16 companies filing 21 bids in total. 21 bids across 8 blocks means an average of 2.6 bids per block and implies at least some blocks drew a single bid, but the per-block split is not published. Round 7 offers the other end of the same pattern: 106 blocks offered, and the subsequent forward auction concluded 6 mines. Low bid-receipt rates are a recurring feature of this programme and should be stated whenever a coal award is cited.

gaps: Bidder counts are the single largest hole in this file. Ministry of Coal PIB round-result tables publish reserve price, final offer and the winning bidder, but never the number of bids received per mine, so every one of the 34 coal rows has bidders: null. No official list of single-bid coal mines exists in any source reached.

NHAI does not publish bidder counts with award announcements, and company Regulation 30 filings disclose only the filer's own position (L1 / LoA received). Only one of the 14 roads rows - TOT bundle 15 - has a sourced bidder count, and that came from trade press, not from NHAI.

NHAI's total AWARDED VALUE per financial year could not be sourced. Only awarded kilometres per year (MoRTH-wide, covering NHAI, NHIDCL and state PWDs) and Bharatmala cumulative value by mode were obtainable. Without an annual value denominator, no company's share of annual NHAI award value can be computed, and none is asserted here.
NHAI TOT bundles 1 through 10: no winner, value or bidder count could be sourced for any of them. The TOT concentration row is therefore a window (bundles 11-19), not the programme.
Winners of NHAI TOT bundles 11, 12 and 16 (Rs 13,245 crore combined) are not named in any source fetched. They are carried as null-winner rows so the denominator is not understated.

PORTS: no rows. Major-port PPP terminal concessions under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways were not reached in this pass. Needs: concession award records from shipmin.gov.in, sagarmala.gov.in and individual major port authority sites, for Adani Ports, JSW Infrastructure, DP World, PSA and J M Baxi, plus a count of how many major-port concessions were awarded in the period as the denominator.

DEFENCE: only two rows, both HAL Tejas Mk1A orders, and neither establishes the process basis. The decisive missing fact is the split between contracts awarded on NOMINATION to defence PSUs (HAL, BEL, BDL, Mazagon Dock, GRSE, Cochin Shipyard, BEML) and those awarded by competitive tender, together with MoD's total capital-acquisition contract count and value per financial year. Without that split, a list of DPSU contract wins would mislead: many are single-vendor by policy, not by competition. mod.gov.in did not respond to fetches from this environment, and the Wikipedia articles on Mazagon Dock and the submarine, frigate and destroyer programmes carry no contract values, dates or process basis, so nothing further could be added.

RAILWAYS: no rows. Needs Vande Bharat trainset contract awards and bidder counts, the Siemens 9000HP locomotive contract, annual wagon procurement totals as a denominator for Titagarh / Jupiter Wagons / Texmaco shares, and the 2020-22 private passenger train tender, where the number of clusters offered against the number of bids received is a documented low-participation outcome worth recording.
FOOD / FCI SILOS: no rows. Needs the count of silo locations tendered versus awarded under the DBFOT/DBFOO model, capacity per operator, and total FCI silo capacity as the denominator.

Group attribution is unconfirmed for several winners. Mahan Energen Ltd, EMIL Mines and Mineral Resources, and Stratatech Mineral Resources appear in the Ministry of Coal file; press reporting associates some of them with the Adani group, but no fetched source establishes it, so winnerGroup is null for those rows. Likewise 'Reliance New Energy Solar Limited', 'Reliance New Solar Energy Limited', 'TP Solar Limited', 'JSW Renewable Technologies Limited' and 'JSW Energy Utkal Limited' are attributed by corporate name only. Under the project's identity test, name match alone is not sufficient; these need confirmation from a company filing or a registrar record.

The 2022 5G spectrum auction is sourced to a trade outlet, not to a fetched government release. PIB began returning 403 and then rate-limited this environment before the 2022 release could be retrieved; the 2024 auction release was retrieved successfully and is the stronger record. The Adani Data Networks figure (400 MHz in 26 GHz for Rs 212 crore) appears only in a search-result summary and not in any page text fetched - it is the weakest number in this file.

The eligibility and prior-experience conditions for the 2018-19 AAI airport round, and whether any were altered before bidding, could not be sourced from a fetched document. This is a process fact that materially changes how the 6-of-6 outcome should be read, in either direction, and it is missing.

ALMM: only a single month's List-I additions and a cumulative total (217,107 MW enlisted, Aug 2026) could be sourced. Company-wise cumulative ALMM capacity - which is what a concentration claim would need - is not published in any source reached, so no ALMM share is asserted.

No cumulative developer league table for SECI/NTPC/NHPC awarded capacity could be obtained with a usable denominator; the trade-press leaderboards are paywalled. The renewables rows are therefore individual auctions, not a market-share picture.

TBCB: the total number and value of ISTS transmission schemes awarded under tariff-based competitive bidding could not be sourced from CEA, the Ministry of Power or a bid process coordinator, so no transmission concentration share is asserted despite two well-documented individual awards with named competing bidders.

CAG Report No. 12 of 2024 was retrieved and keyword-scanned for NHAI findings on bidder participation, single-bid tenders or award concentration. Its NHAI paragraphs concern recovery of damages from concessionaires, toll-notification delays and maintenance lapses. No audit finding on procurement concentration was located - recorded as a documented absence, not as an unchecked gap.

eprocure.gov.in (CPPP) and gem.gov.in did not respond to fetches from this environment, so the two portals that would give a population-level view of central procurement - rather than a sector-by-sector sample - contributed nothing. This is the reason the headline base rate is null.

This file has no control group. Under the project's symmetry check, the same method should be run against an earlier government's award record and against a rival conglomerate before any concentration figure here is treated as meaningful. It has not been.
